cards.ex: The report revealed deep-seated prejudice within the police force.
cards.exUz: Hisobotda politsiya kuchlari ichida chuqur ildiz otgan kamsitish borligi aniqlandi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq va uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan, odamlarning ongiga chuqur singgan kamsitish.

cards.ex: Tackling entrenched inequality requires long-term systemic changes.
cards.exUz: Mustahkam tengsizlikka qarshi kurashish uzoq muddatli tizimli o'zgarishlarni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida mavjud bo'lib, o'zgarishi qiyin bo'lgan tengsizlik.

cards.ex: The education system is becoming a two-tiered system, with the rich getting better opportunities.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim tizimi ikki qavatli tizimga aylanib bormoqda, boylar yaxshiroq imkoniyatlarga ega.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda ikki xil darajadagi imkoniyatlar yoki imtiyozlar mavjudligi.

cards.ex: Disparities in wealth are growing, leading to social unrest.
cards.exUz: Boylikdagi farqlar ortib bormoqda, bu ijtimoiy norozilikka olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Boylikning turli guruhlar o'rtasida notekis taqsimlanishi.

cards.ex: When social mobility stalls, frustration and resentment build up.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy harakat to'xtaganda, umidsizlik va xafagarchilik kuchayadi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning ijtimoiy mavqeini yaxshilash imkoniyati kamayadi.

cards.ex: Many promising students from poor backgrounds fall by the wayside due to lack of support.
cards.exUz: Qo'llab-quvvatlashning etishmasligi sababli kambag'al oilalardan chiqqan ko'plab istiqbolli talabalar e'tibordan chetda qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolar tufayli o'z maqsadiga erisha olmaslik.

cards.ex: Old prejudices still hold sway in some sectors of society.
cards.exUz: Eski kamsitishlar jamiyatning ba'zi sohalarida hanuzgacha hukmronlik qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta ta'sirga ega bo'lmoq, hukmronlik qilmoq.

cards.ex: We need to turn the tide against growing inequality.
cards.exUz: Biz ortib borayotgan tengsizlikka qarshi vaziyatni o'zgartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Many workers in the factory felt they were under the thumb of the management.
cards.exUz: Fabrikadagi ko'plab ishchilar o'zlarini boshqaruvning nazorati ostida his qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa birining nazorati ostida, bo'ysunuv holatida.

cards.ex: Rising crime rates are tearing at the social fabric of the city.
cards.exUz: Jinoyatning ortishi shaharning ijtimoiy to'qimasini yirtmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning tuzilishi va odamlar o'rtasidagi munosabatlar.

cards.ex: There's a widening chasm between the rich and the poor in this country.
cards.exUz: Bu mamlakatda boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasida kengayib borayotgan jarlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Turli guruhlar o'rtasidagi katta farq yoki ajralish.

cards.ex: The government is trying to redress the balance by investing in poorer areas.
cards.exUz: Hukumat kambag'al hududlarga sarmoya kiritish orqali muvozanatni tiklashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Adolatsizlikni tuzatish yoki tengsizlikni bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: We need to ensure that everyone starts on equal footing.
cards.exUz: Hamma teng sharoitlarda boshlashini ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Teng huquq va imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The poorest communities often bear the brunt of environmental disasters.
cards.exUz: Eng kambag'al jamoalar ko'pincha ekologik falokatlarning eng yomon oqibatlariga duchor bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatning eng yomon oqibatlariga duchor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The government uses subsidies to prop up the agricultural sector.
cards.exUz: Hukumat qishloq xo'jaligi sektorini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun subsidiyalardan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Yiqilishdan saqlash, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The pandemic has exacerbated inequality across the globe.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya butun dunyo bo'ylab tengsizlikni kuchaytirdi.
cards.uzDef: Tengsizlikni yanada yomonlashtirish.

cards.ex: Access to good healthcare can be a postcode lottery in some countries.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda yaxshi sog'liqni saqlash xizmatlariga kirish manzil lotereyasi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yashash joyingizga qarab imkoniyatlarning farqi.

cards.ex: Immigration can threaten social cohesion if not managed properly.
cards.exUz: Immigratsiya to'g'ri boshqarilmasa, ijtimoiy birdamlikka tahdid solishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi odamlar o'rtasidagi birlik va hamjihatlik.

cards.ex: It's becoming increasingly difficult for young people to get ahead in life.
cards.exUz: Yoshlarning hayotda oldinga siljishi tobora qiyinlashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muaffaqiyatga erishish, martaba o'stirish.

cards.ex: We should give everyone the benefit of the doubt until proven otherwise.
cards.exUz: Aksini isbotlanmaguncha, hammaga shubhani bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir aybsiz deb hisoblash, ishonch bildirish.

cards.ex: We need to address the root causes of poverty, not just treat the symptoms.
cards.exUz: Biz kambag'allikning faqat alomatlarini davolash bilan cheklanib qolmasdan, asosiy sabablarini hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning eng chuqur, asosiy sabablari.

cards.ex: Many women still face a glass ceiling in their careers.
cards.exUz: Ko'p ayollar o'z faoliyatida hali ham shisha shiftga duch kelishadi.
cards.uzDef: Ayollarning yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qiluvchi yashirin to'siq.

cards.ex: People from poorer backgrounds often find it hard to climb the social ladder.
cards.exUz: Kambag'al oilalardan chiqqan odamlar ijtimoiy zinapoyadan ko'tarilishni qiyin deb bilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi odamlarning ijtimoiy mavqei va boyligiga qarab joylashuvi.

cards.ex: We need to raise awareness about the issue of homelessness.
cards.exUz: Biz uysizlik muammosi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarga muammo haqida ko'proq ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: Education can help break down barriers between different social classes.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim turli ijtimoiy tabaqalar o'rtasidagi to'siqlarni yo'q qilishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar o'rtasidagi adolatsizlikni keltirib chiqaradigan to'siqlarni yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: Tax reforms are needed to narrow the gap between the rich and the poor.
cards.exUz: Boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi farqni qisqartirish uchun soliq islohotlari zarur.
cards.uzDef: Ikki guruh o'rtasidagi farqni kamaytirish (masalan, boy va kambag'al).

cards.ex: It's hard to challenge entrenched privilege in some societies.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi jamiyatlarda mustahkam imtiyozga qarshi kurashish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Ba'zi odamlarning jamiyatda uzoq vaqtdan beri ega bo'lgan adolatsiz ustunligi.

cards.ex: Losing his job sent him into a downward spiral of depression and debt.
cards.exUz: Ishidan ayrilishi uni depressiya va qarzning pastga qarab harakatiga tushirdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tobora yomonlashuvi.

cards.ex: The system is rigged; it's an uneven playing field for minorities.
cards.exUz: Tizim sozlangan; bu ozchiliklar uchun tengsiz sharoit.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun bir xil imkoniyatlar yo'qligi, adolatsizlik.

cards.ex: Many families are living hand to mouth due to the economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina oilalar iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli og'zidan yirtib yashamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta qiyinchilik bilan, faqat zarur narsalarga yetadigan darajada yashash.
